cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: an antique shop — glass cabinets of old coins and trinkets, a brass scale, a rolltop desk and a velvet armchair
cuts.scene: she is a shop clerk sitting with legs crossed, holding an antique pocket watch and trying to guess its age
cuts.outfit: an antique dealer look fitted to her body — a fitted velvet vest over a collared blouse and a short skirt with a brooch, bare legs, a plain gold-colored coin on a cord
